description:
Roll back an environment — Rolls this environment back to a prior pinned version (FR-018..FR-023). `target_version` must name a successful forward-promote deployment row on this env — rollback re-runs the deployment at that row's `commit_sha`. Rollback is a promote at an older commit: it writes a fresh env-keyed snapshot, commits the env pointer, and dispatches the build. Returns 202 with the created `deployment` row; poll `GET /v1/deployments/{deployment_id}` to watch the build complete.

Feature-gated: while the `enable_env_rollback` flag is OFF for the caller's tenant this route responds `404` as if it did not exist.
name: rollback_environment
